user.title: Configure Effy
user.description: Set up effective PV loss distribution. Select your PV input sources and your BMS input sources (battery import, grid import) and output sinks (battery export, grid export).

data.bms_input_sensors: BMS input sensors (BMS import from battery/grid)

error.at_least_one_input: Please select at least one input sensor (PV or BMS).
error.sensor_in_both_input_lists: A sensor cannot be both a PV input and a BMS input. Please remove it from one of the two lists.
error.at_least_one_output: Please select at least one output sensor.
error.output_needs_device_class: Every output sensor must have a device class (power or energy) set. Please pick a different sensor or fix its device class first.
